summary: Iteration 10: Full testing of animated skin previews and skin gifting features. All 8 backend API tests PASSED. Frontend UI animations and gift functionality verified.
passed_tests: GET /api/skins/catalog - Returns all skins with correct data
POST /api/skins/gift - Correctly rejects invalid skin ID (400 error)
POST /api/skins/gift - Correctly rejects gifting default skin (400 error)
GET /api/skins/gifts/{wallet} - Returns empty array for new wallet
POST /api/skins/gift - Full gift flow: purchase -> gift -> ownership transfer -> gift history
POST /api/skins/gift - Requires all fields (sender_wallet, recipient_wallet, skin_id)
UI: Skin store subtitle shows 'Gift to friends'
UI: Animated skin preview on hover (image scales with scale-110 class)
UI: Hover glow effect with box-shadow animation
UI: Full-screen preview modal with floating animation (skin-float class)
UI: Gift button correctly hidden for default skin
UI: Gift button visible on owned skins (except default)
UI: Gift modal with recipient wallet input field
UI: 12 skin cards displayed with data-testid attributes
critical_code_review_comments: Gift API correctly validates ownership before allowing gift transfer
Gift history properly tracks both sent and received gifts
Notifications sent to both sender and recipient on successful gift
CSS animations defined both inline (style jsx) in SkinStore.js and in animations.css for redundancy
seed_data_creation: Test skin purchases and gifts created with TEST_ prefix wallet addresses for full gift flow test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 verified animated skin previews and gifting features: 1) Backend: POST /api/skins/gift transfers ownership from sender to recipient, validates ownership/prevents self-gift/rejects default skin, 2) Backend: GET /api/skins/gifts/{wallet} returns gift history with sent/received types, 3) Frontend: Hover over skin shows scale-110 zoom and glow effect, 4) Frontend: Click on skin opens full-screen preview modal with floating animation (skin-float), sparkle particles (animate-sparkle), and spinning background (animate-spin-slow), 5) Frontend: Gift button appears on hover for owned skins (except default), opens gift modal with recipient wallet input

ui_elements.gift_button: Visible on owned skins (except default) on hover
ui_elements.gift_modal: Modal with recipient wallet input, skin preview, warning message
ui_elements.gift_history: Shown at bottom of store when wallet connected and has gifts
